scope: General cash policy for current and future branches using the existing commercial checkout. Existing accepted agreements and orders are not rewritten.

calculation.basis: Entire invoice after discounts, delivery, base service and tip. One total rounding; signed difference changes platform service only.
calculation.minimum: Effective cash service fee >=250 IQD. If requested rounded total violates this, use the first collectible total meeting the minimum, preserve requested total and explicit override reason.
calculation.nonCash: Pure calculator bypasses cash rounding. No payment gateway has been enabled.
calculation.disabled: Explicitly disabled cash policy retains exact totals. Missing required policy blocks checkout.

audit.posting: Base fee credited to SERVICE_FEE_REVENUE. Positive difference credited and negative difference debited to CASH_ROUNDING_SERVICE_ADJUSTMENT. No double posting of effective service.
audit.customerView: Only effective service and final invoice; no rounding settlement line or internal evidence.
invariants: retries preserve exactly one order/benefit reservation/journal

validation.browser: Desktop/mobile policy simulation, minimum override, direct save, history and stale-result clearing passed using local fixtures.
validation.analyzer: No errors or warnings; existing informational style/deprecation findings remain.
validation.live: Published Lambda hashes, active policy, hosting bytes and unauthenticated handler rejection verified. No authenticated live order or financial mutation performed for tests.

deployment: Narrow overlays on freshly captured live archives preserve colleague changes. Completion and reporting deployed before policy activation. Required-policy fence enabled on actual order writer.
permissions: Create-order exact cash-policy read/condition fence; company projected-read attribute list extended only by cashRounding. Existing employee authorization and commercial consent retained.
rollback: Keep compatible completion/report readers while rounded orders exist. Change policy through a new audited version; never delete accepted financial evidence or rewrite historical orders. Captured base archives permit code/hosting recovery after draining incompatible in-flight work.
